ruleBookInfo.name: h1@text
ruleBookInfo.author: @js: var m = src.match(/"author"[\s\S]*?"name":"([^"]+)"/); m ? m[1] : ''
ruleBookInfo.kind: @js: var re = /href="[^"]*\/genre\/[^"]*"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>/g; var gs=[]; var m; while((m=re.exec(src))!==null){gs.push(m[1]);} gs.join('，')
ruleBookInfo.tocUrl: @js: var m = baseUrl.match(/\/works\/([^-]+)/); m ? 'https://hipapi.s3file.top/v1/manga/chapters?mid=' + m[1] + '&page=1&per_page=1000&order=asc' : baseUrl

ruleToc.chapterUrl: @js: var hid = jsonItem.hid; var di = hid.indexOf('-'); var p1 = hid.substring(0, di); var p2 = hid.substring(di + 1); var d1 = Buffer.from(p1, 'base64').toString('utf8'); var typeId = d1.substring(d1.indexOf('-') + 1); var ap1 = Buffer.from(typeId).toString('base64').replace(/=/g, ''); 'https://hipapi1.s3file.top/v1/chapter?hid=' + ap1 + '-' + p2
ruleToc.nextTocUrl: @js: var d = JSON.parse(result).data; d && d.page < d.total_pages ? baseUrl.replace(/([?&]page=)\d+/, function(m, g){ return g + (d.page + 1); }) : ''

ruleContent.content: @js: var data = JSON.parse(result); var d = data.data || data; var imgs = d.images || (d.chapter && d.chapter.images) || []; imgs.map(function(i){ var url = typeof i === 'string' ? i : (i.url || i.src || ''); return url ? '' : ''; }).filter(function(s){ return s; }).join('\n')
